svg.title: RAG Workflow Lab - detailed pipeline and implementation status
svg.desc: Source preparation, current and planned RAG paths, output validation, tracing, and six retrieval metrics. Updated 25 November 2026.
svg.text: Supervisor discussion | Updated 25 November 2026 | Basic = Simple in the codebase
Dashed: planned connection; tags state build status
A. BEFORE QUESTIONS - PREPARE SHARED, VERSIONED EVIDENCE
Public documentation and fictional deployment facts.
Immutable HTML / Markdown; source IDs and hashes.
Preserve sections, SQL blocks and tables.
Local Nomic Embed Text v1.5, 768-dimensional vectors.
B. QUESTION TIME - ONE SELECTED WORKFLOW, THEN ANSWER VALIDATION
Compare fixed vs dynamic control with equal tools.
Measure answer quality, cost and latency.
Later: can routing choose a cheaper adequate path?
Final protocol and held-out set: OPEN.
DONE | one retrieval pass; no reranking or sandbox tools
Enhanced RAG - components exist; workflow composition not built
SHARED SANDBOX TOOLS [NOT BUILT]: allowed DB inspection and EXPLAIN for permitted query IDs
Enhanced: fixed Python conditions/order | Agentic: model chooses actions | Same relevant tools; fixtures/contracts OPEN
NOT BUILT | exact retrieval policy OPEN
Repeat only if more evidence is needed; bounds not yet defined
A valid citation label alone does not
prove that the source supports a claim.
Trace = one question/workflow; span = one operation.
DONE: Simple retrieval + LLM; PostgreSQL traces / spans.
Recorded: prompt, chunk ranks/IDs, answer, tokens, timings/errors.
Cost remains NULL when unknown; tool calls are not fabricated.
NOT BUILT: reranker, router, DB-tool and validator spans.
RRF top-20 -> score every pair -> measure prefixes at 5 / 10 / 20; full ranks are saved.
Four-question batch-one probes: Qwen4B 27.90 s/question; Qwen0.6B 5.95 s/question.
Batch four: one P05 check took 46.36 s versus 30.85 s at batch one; no speed gain shown.
120-question 4B run: user-reported in progress; completed full-set results not reviewed.
Final model/context budget: OPEN. Reranker benchmarks write JSON; tracing integration pending.
D. OFFLINE DEVELOPMENT EVALUATION - SEPARATE FROM THE USER RESPONSE PATH
Six retrieval-quality metrics at k = 5, 10, 20 | Means: 100 answerable questions | 20 unanswerable cases reported separately
what fraction appears in the first k?
Of all required claims, what fraction has
its annotated support in the first k?
required claims are all supported at k.
Annotated reference hits in the first k / k.
The denominator stays k for short result lists.
Mean 1/rank of the first reference hit.
No reference hit in the first k gives zero.
Rewards reference chunks near the top;
These metrics assess retrieved evidence, not LLM answer accuracy. Labels are not exhaustive; unannotated passages remain unjudged.
120 development questions; held-out thesis test set and final protocol OPEN. Later: compare Simple / Enhanced / Agentic / routed / LLM-only.
